correctness.rationale: The multiset signature of each half-graph vertex is determined exactly by side landmark cardinalities, membership status, and a suffix or prefix landmark count. Same-side injectivity gives four cardinality inequalities and the n-1 lower bound. Odd equality forces a cross-side collision; even equality forces the two alternating bases. At odd minimum size, one singleton count block and the opposite-side no-repeat condition yield the indexed one-switch families. The checker exhaustively confirms all bases through n=9.

value.rationale: The half graph is the canonical twin-free chain graph, making it a natural family for measuring information loss when ordered distance vectors are replaced by multisets. The theorem reveals a nontrivial parity law, complete even-order rigidity, and an exact quadratic odd-order basis count.
